title: Curiosity-0826-4B: Generative Medical Event Sequence Modeling Across Pediatric and Adult Populations
abstract: arXiv:2611.15710v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Curiosity-0826-4B, an updated version of the generative medical event foundation model trained on Epic Cosmos that simulates patient timelines to produce zero-shot clinical predictions. Curiosity-0826-4B incorporates a broader patient population and richer clinical event representations, while generally matching or exceeding Curiosity-0226-1B, the largest model in the previous Curiosity-0226 series, on evaluated tasks supported by both models. Laboratory value prediction improved, with MAE 18--46% lower than that of Curiosity-0226-1B. We evaluated prediction of disease events across pediatric cohorts aged 2--17 years. AUROCs for new asthma diagnosis (0.742--0.785) and asthma exacerbation (0.829--0.852) were comparable to those in the adult reference cohort, while AUROCs for sickle cell crisis (0.820--0.847) were lower than in adults (0.915). Explicit representation of documented death enabled new mortality prediction tasks

translated_title: Curiosity-0826-4B：面向儿科与成人人群的生成式医疗事件序列建模
translated_abstract: 我们介绍 Curiosity-0826-4B，这是在 Epic Cosmos 上训练的生成式医疗事件基础模型的更新版本，它通过模拟患者时间线来产生零样本临床预测。Curiosity-0826-4B 涵盖了更广泛的患者人群和更丰富的临床事件表示，在两个模型均支持的评估任务上总体持平或超越上一个 Curiosity-0226 系列中最大的模型 Curiosity-0226-1B。实验室数值预测得到改进，其平均绝对误差（MAE）比 Curiosity-0226-1B 低 18%–46%。我们在 2–17 岁的儿科队列中评估了疾病事件预测：新发哮喘诊断的 AUROC（0.742–0.785）和哮喘急性加重的 AUROC（0.829–0.852）与成人参考队列相当，而镰状细胞危象的 AUROC（0.820–0.847）低于成人水平（0.915）。对已记录死亡的显式表示使新的死亡率预测任务成为可能。
tldr: Curiosity-0826-4B 是基于 Epic Cosmos 训练的升级版生成式医疗事件基础模型，通过扩大患者人群覆盖（首次纳入儿科队列）和更丰富的临床事件表示，将实验室数值预测误差降低 18%–46%，并借助死亡的显式表示新增了儿科疾病预测与死亡率预测能力。
en_tdlr: Curiosity-0826-4B is an upgraded generative medical event foundation model trained on Epic Cosmos that extends coverage to pediatric populations with richer clinical event representations, reduces lab value prediction MAE by 18–46%, and enables new pediatric disease and mortality prediction tasks through explicit death representation.
